summary: Glucotrack, Inc. disclosed in an 8-K that, on September 4, 2026, it entered into a Settlement and Release Agreement with Alto Opportunity Master Fund, RXRR Capital Partners LLC, Erik Emerson and L'kahi Therapeutics, resolving disputes tied to Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US, Inc. debt of roughly $10.9 million. Glucotrack and other settling parties jointly and severally owe Alto $2.0 million cash, a $2.0 million convertible note, and up to $125,000 in legal fees. The 5% note amortizes in four $500,000 quarterly installments from November 30, 2026, through August 31, 2027, and converts at $2.98 per share with a 9.99% beneficial-ownership cap and Nasdaq limits. Watch default/acceleration risk and equity dilution.
